title: Surreal Blue Orbs Sunset
description: A vibrant surreal landscape depicts rolling green and golden fields under a dramatic sky filled with swirling orange, red, and yellow patterns. Numerous floating blue spheres of varying sizes, some with thin connecting lines, dominate the upper portion above a distant purple mountain range and a bright setting sun.
prompt: A vibrant surreal landscape with rolling green and golden fields in the foreground, distant purple hills, and a bright yellow sun setting on the horizon. The sky is a swirling vortex of fiery orange, red, and yellow brushstrokes filled with dozens of floating dark blue spheres and orbs of different sizes connected by thin lines, expressive painterly style with visible brushwork.
